items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I had done a gig up in Connecticut for Bill Ratzenberger.

ctx.x: That was in either January or February of 1975.
Yes. I had done a gig up in Connecticut for Bill Ratzenberger. And Beaver Harris was on drums. And it turned out that Beaver Harris was also from Pittsburgh, so it was --
Yes, he played with -- in fact, he played on the Homestead baseball team.
